title: Acquired resistance to immunotherapy and chemoradiation in MYC amplified head and neck cancer
body:
##  Acquired resistance to immunotherapy and chemoradiation in MYC amplified head and neck cancer 

In the May 2024 issue of NPJ Precision Oncology, [Cyberski et al.](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41698-024-00606-w>) used Reactome’s hierarchically arranged pathways with their in silico Pathway Activation Network Decomposition Analysis (iPANDA) algorithm to identify upregulation of networks associated with [cell cycle ](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-1640170>)progression, [signal transduction](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-162582>), and [metabolism](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-1430728>) and down-regulation of [immune cellular process ](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-168256>)and [apoptosis](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-109581&PATH=R-HSA-5357801>) in MYC-amplified cases of recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
